summary: You prepare, in five sentences or a 60-second voice note, what you will say about what is not real in your project (with a real example of something that broke and one thing you do not know yet) and three questions to ask in the room. A real preflight run shows 7 checks in 16 seconds, and a packing list and a rest rule close the week.
goal: Prepare what you say about what is not real, and your questions.

items.text: Write your two-line answer to 'what did not work' without notes
Write 5 sentences or record 60 seconds: the honest limit, a number, something that broke, what you do not know yet, your questions
Run your one command that checks everything and predict its time first
Do the packing list and test your laptop offline
Play the Ready Check game to the end and see your score
